<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>AIGOGY Learning Designer</title>
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#071a33; --navy2:#0b2344; --blue:#1377ff; --blue2:#4ca0ff; --gold:#f8c85a;
  --white:#ffffff; --ink:#122033; --muted:#64748b; --card:#ffffff; --bg:#eef5ff; --line:#dfe8f4;
  --green:#1fa971; --orange:#f59e0b; --red:#e75b5b;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#eef5ff 0%,#f8fbff 50%,#fff8e6 100%);color:var(--ink)}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.app{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(7,26,51,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:white;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.topbar-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.4px;white-space:nowrap}
.brand span{color:var(--gold)}
.stepper{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:1;justify-content:center;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:#b8c8dc;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.step.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.step.done{color:#fff}
.dot{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#23415f;font-size:11px}
.step.active .dot{background:#fff;color:var(--blue)}
.step.done .dot{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.progress-mini{height:4px;background:#163556}
.progress-mini>div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--blue));width:0;transition:.25s}
main{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px 14px 26px}
.screen{display:none;width:100%;max-width:1100px;animation:fade .25s ease}
.screen.active{display:block}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:.3;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071a33 0%,#102a54 65%,#173d70 100%);border-radius:30px;color:white;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(7,26,51,.24);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;min-height:610px}
.hero-copy{padding:46px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:max-content;background:rgba(248,200,90,.14);border:1px solid rgba(248,200,90,.35);color:#ffe6a7;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,78px);line-height:.95;margin:18px 0 14px;letter-spacing:-2px}
.hero h1 span{display:block;color:var(--gold)}
.hero p{font-size:20px;color:#d7e4f4;max-width:650px;line-height:1.5}
.workflow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin:24px 0}
.workflow-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:14px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.workflow-card b{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:5px}
.workflow-card small{color:#d5e1ee;line-height:1.35}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.challenge{font-weight:900;font-size:13px;color:#d4e1f0;letter-spacing:.6px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 18px;font-weight:900;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:50px;transition:.2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#ffd979);color:#2b240f;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(248,200,90,.25)}
.btn-blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#1d8cff);color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(19,119,255,.22)}
.btn-secondary{background:#edf4fd;color:#16385d}
.hero-visual{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 35%,rgba(76,160,255,.28),transparent 44%)}
.avatar{width:min(360px,86%);aspect-ratio:1/1.25;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border-radius:36px 36px 0 0;filter:saturate(.95) contrast(1.02);box-shadow:0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.visual-orbs span{position:absolute;border-radius:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:34px;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.visual-orbs .o1{width:72px;height:72px;left:8%;top:15%} .visual-orbs .o2{width:66px;height:66px;right:8%;top:24%} .visual-orbs .o3{width:62px;height:62px;left:12%;bottom:12%} .visual-orbs .o4{width:70px;height:70px;right:9%;bottom:14%}
.panel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(40,73,110,.13);overflow:hidden}
.panel-head{padding:24px 26px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:var(--blue);letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
.panel h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);margin:4px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-1px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin:0}
.timebadge{background:#fff4cf;color:#74580d;font-weight:900;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
.panel-body{padding:22px 26px 24px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
label{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#36506b;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;border:1.5px solid #d9e5f2;background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 14px;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:.2s}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(19,119,255,.1)}
textarea{min-height:88px;resize:vertical}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
.choice{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;text-align:left;min-height:100px;transition:.18s}
.choice:hover{border-color:#b9d4f4;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.choice.selected{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(19,119,255,.11);background:#f4f9ff}
.choice .icon{font-size:25px;margin-bottom:7px}
.choice b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.choice small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3}
.actions{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.actions .right{margin-left:auto}
.think-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071a33,#10376c);border-radius:22px;padding:20px;color:white;margin-bottom:16px}
.think-banner small{display:block;color:#bad0e8;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px}
.think-banner strong{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,32px)}
.think-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.think-card{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:13px;text-align:left;min-height:96px}
.think-card.selected{border-color:var(--blue);background:#f3f8ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(19,119,255,.09)}
.think-card.disabled{opacity:.45}
.think-card .top{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:5px}
.think-card b{font-size:13px}
.think-card small{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.28}
.limitnote{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0}
.example-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;margin:14px 0 9px;scrollbar-width:none}
.tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:#35506d;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 11px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.tab.active{background:#0e2c54;color:white;border-color:#0e2c54}
.example-box{background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #dce9f7;border-radius:18px;padding:14px}
.example-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:8px 0}
.example-row+.example-row{border-top:1px dashed #cfdeef}
.bad{color:#b94c4c;font-weight:900;font-size:12px} .good{color:#178456;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}
.question-card{margin-top:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff8dc,#fffdf6);border:1.5px solid #f6d87c;border-radius:20px;padding:18px}
.question-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:18px}
.checklist{display:grid;gap:9px}
.check{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:12px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.check input{width:20px;height:20px;margin-top:1px;accent-color:var(--green)}
.status{margin-top:14px;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;font-weight:900}
.status.ready{background:#e8f8f0;color:#14754f} .status.review{background:#fff3dc;color:#945c00}
.prompt-card{background:#071a33;color:#eaf2fb;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;max-height:440px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.tool-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:12px}
.toolbtn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;font-weight:900;color:#173858}
.materials{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.material{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:11px;text-align:left;font-weight:800}
.material.selected{border-color:var(--blue);background:#f2f8ff}
.mini-prompt{margin-top:10px;background:#f4f8fc;border-radius:14px;padding:13px;font-size:13px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.share-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.saved-note{font-size:12px;color:#526c87;background:#edf5ff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:10px}
.completion{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071a33,#10376c);border-radius:30px;color:white;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;min-height:570px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(7,26,51,.24)}
.complete-copy{padding:46px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.complete-copy h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);margin:10px 0;letter-spacing:-1.7px}
.complete-list{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:18px 0 24px}
.complete-list div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px}
.completion .hero-visual{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,rgba(248,200,90,.22),transparent 46%)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#0b2344;color:white;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;display:none;z-index:99}
.toast.show{display:block}
.helper{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
@media(max-width:850px){
 .topbar-inner{padding:8px 10px} .brand{font-size:13px} .stepper{justify-content:flex-start} .step{padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px}
 main{align-items:flex-start;padding:12px 10px 24px}
 .hero,.completion{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto} .hero-copy,.complete-copy{padding:28px 22px} .hero-visual{min-height:280px;padding-top:10px}
 .avatar{width:240px;aspect-ratio:1/1.2} .workflow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .workflow-card{padding:11px}
 .panel{border-radius:22px} .panel-head{padding:18px 17px 12px} .panel-body{padding:16px 17px 18px}
 .grid2,.share-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .field.full{grid-column:auto}
 .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .think-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .tool-buttons{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .materials{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .actions{position:sticky;bottom:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);padding:8px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(26,60,96,.14)}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
 .step span.label{display:none} .step{gap:0} .dot{width:28px;height:28px}
 h1{font-size:48px} .hero p{font-size:17px} .workflow-card small{font-size:11px}
 .cards,.think-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .choice{min-height:auto}
 .panel h2{font-size:34px} .tool-buttons,.materials{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .example-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <header class="topbar" id="topbar" style="display:none">
    <div class="topbar-inner">
      <div class="brand"><span>AIGOGY</span> Learning Designer</div>
      <div class="stepper">
        <div class="step" data-step="1"><span class="dot">1</span><span class="label">BUILD</span></div>
        <div class="step" data-step="2"><span class="dot">2</span><span class="label">THINK</span></div>
        <div class="step" data-step="3"><span class="dot">3</span><span class="label">CHECK</span></div>
        <div class="step" data-step="4"><span class="dot">4</span><span class="label">ASSIGN</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="progress-mini"><div id="progressBar"></div></div>
  </header>
  <main>
    <section class="screen active" id="screen-welcome">
      <div class="hero">
        <div class="hero-copy">
          <div class="kicker">✦ 15-MINUTE DESIGN CHALLENGE</div>
          <h1>AIGOGY <span>LEARNING DESIGNER</span></h1>
          <p>Turn one lesson idea into a meaningful learning task.</p>
          <div class="workflow">
            <div class="workflow-card"><b>BUILD</b><small>Make the learning goal clear.</small></div>
            <div class="workflow-card"><b>THINK</b><small>Make student thinking visible.</small></div>
            <div class="workflow-card"><b>CHECK</b><small>Ensure AI supports learning.</small></div>
            <div class="workflow-card"><b>ASSIGN</b><small>Generate your classroom-ready prompt.</small></div>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="goTo(1)">START DESIGNING →</button><div class="challenge">PEDAGOGY LEADS. AI SUPPORTS.</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-visual">
          <div class="visual-orbs"><span class="o1">🧠</span><span class="o2">🔬</span><span class="o3">📊</span><span class="o4">💡</span></div>
          <img class="avatar" alt="Teacher avatar" src="data:image/png;base64," />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-1">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">1. BUILD</div><h2>Build the learning task</h2><p class="sub">Start with the learning — not the AI tool.</p></div><div class="timebadge">≈ 4 min</div></div>
        <div class="panel-body">
          <div class="grid2">
            <div class="field"><label>Subject</label><select id="subject" onchange="toggleOtherSubject()"><option value="">Select subject</option><option>Bahasa Melayu</option><option>English</option><option>Mathematics</option><option>Science</option><option>Biology</option><option>Chemistry</option><option>Physics</option><option>Pendidikan Islam</option><option>Sejarah</option><option>Geografi</option><option>RBT</option><option>Computer Science</option><option>Physical Education</option><option>Visual Arts</option><option>Other</option></select><input id="subjectOther" placeholder="Type your subject" style="display:none;margin-top:7px"/></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Topic / Concept</label><input id="topic" placeholder="Photosynthesis • Linear equations • Solat Jamak..."/></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Student Level</label><select id="level" onchange="toggleOtherLevel()"><option value="">Select level</option><option>Primary</option><option>Form 1</option><option>Form 2</option><option>Form 3</option><option>Form 4</option><option>Form 5</option><option>Other</option></select><input id="levelOther" placeholder="Type student level" style="display:none;margin-top:7px"/></div>
            <div class="field"><label>What should students know or be able to do?</label><textarea id="objective" placeholder="By the end of the lesson, students should be able to..."></textarea></div>
            <div class="field full"><label>What will students do? Choose ONE primary task.</label><div class="cards" id="taskCards"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(0)">← Back</button><button class="btn btn-blue right" onclick="nextFromBuild()">NEXT — MAKE THINKING VISIBLE →</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-2">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">2. THINK</div><h2>Make thinking visible</h2><p class="sub">Select how students will show evidence of their thinking.</p></div><div class="timebadge">≈ 5 min</div></div>
        <div class="panel-body">
          <div class="think-banner"><small>AI can help create the product. But...</small><strong>CAN YOU SEE THE STUDENT'S THINKING?</strong></div>
          <div class="think-grid" id="thinkingCards"></div>
          <p class="limitnote">Choose up to THREE. You can continue with one strategy.</p>
          <div class="example-tabs" id="exampleTabs"></div>
          <div class="example-box" id="exampleBox"></div>
          <div class="question-card"><h3>Thinking question</h3><div style="font-weight:900;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:8px">IF AI COULD PRODUCE THE FINAL PRODUCT FOR THE STUDENT... WHAT EVIDENCE WOULD STILL PROVE THAT THE STUDENT UNDERSTANDS THE LEARNING?</div><textarea id="evidenceAnswer" placeholder="Example: student explanation, working steps, highlighted evidence, comparison, reflection..."></textarea></div>
          <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(1)">← Back</button><button class="btn btn-blue right" onclick="nextFromThink()">NEXT — CHECK THE TASK →</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-3">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">3. CHECK</div><h2>Check the learning design</h2><p class="sub">Before giving the task to students, make sure the important thinking remains.</p></div><div class="timebadge">≈ 2 min</div></div>
        <div class="panel-body">
          <div class="checklist" id="checklist"></div>
          <div id="checkStatus" class="status review">🟠 ONE MORE LOOK — Consider strengthening the thinking requirement before assigning the task.</div>
          <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(2)">← Back</button><button class="btn btn-blue right" onclick="goTo(4)">CONTINUE — GENERATE PROMPT →</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-4">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">4. ASSIGN</div><h2>Your classroom-ready AI prompt</h2><p class="sub">Learning first. Prompt second. AI tool last.</p></div><div class="timebadge">≈ 2 min</div></div>
        <div class="panel-body">
          <div class="prompt-card" id="promptOutput"></div>
          <div class="tool-buttons">
            <button class="toolbtn" onclick="copyPrompt()">📋 COPY PROMPT</button>
            <button class="toolbtn" onclick="openAI('chatgpt')">🤖 OPEN IN CHATGPT</button>
            <button class="toolbtn" onclick="openAI('gemini')">✨ OPEN IN GEMINI</button>
            <button class="toolbtn" onclick="adaptNotebookLM()">📚 ADAPT FOR NOTEBOOKLM</button>
          </div>
          <div id="notebookWrap" style="display:none"><div class="mini-prompt" id="notebookPrompt"></div><button class="btn btn-secondary" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="copyText('notebookPrompt')">Copy NotebookLM Prompt</button></div>
          <div style="margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px">
            <div class="eyebrow">Optional — Use the same idea again</div><h3 style="margin:4px 0 6px">ONE LEARNING IDEA → MANY MATERIALS</h3><p class="sub">Keep this secondary. The learning objective stays the same.</p>
            <div class="materials" id="materialChoices"></div>
            <div id="materialPromptWrap" style="display:none"><div class="mini-prompt" id="materialPrompt"></div><button class="btn btn-secondary" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="copyText('materialPrompt')">Copy Material Prompt</button></div>
          </div>
          <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(3)">← Back</button><button class="btn btn-blue right" onclick="goTo(5)">NEXT — SHARE YOUR DESIGN →</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-5">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SHARE YOUR DESIGN</div><h2>Capture the learning design</h2><p class="sub">Only the essentials. No unnecessary personal data.</p></div><div class="timebadge">≈ 2 min</div></div>
        <div class="panel-body">
          <div class="share-grid">
            <div class="field"><label>Subject / Unit</label><input id="shareSubject"/></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Final Task</label><textarea id="shareTask"></textarea></div>
            <div class="field"><label>How will student thinking be visible?</label><textarea id="shareThinking"></textarea></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Optional: One thing I will try after this workshop</label><textarea id="shareTry"></textarea></div>
          </div>
          <div class="saved-note">Submission is saved only in this browser on this device using local storage. It is not sent to a server or Google Sheet unless you connect one.</div>
          <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(4)">← Back</button><button class="btn btn-blue right" onclick="submitDesign()">SUBMIT MY DESIGN →</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="screen" id="screen-complete">
      <div class="completion">
        <div class="complete-copy">
          <div class="kicker">🎉 DESIGN COMPLETE</div>
          <h2>YOUR LEARNING TASK IS READY</h2>
          <p style="font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);margin:0">Pedagogy Leads. AI Supports.</p>
          <div class="complete-list"><div>✓ You designed the learning first.</div><div>✓ AI helped you build the material.</div><div>✓ Student thinking remains visible.</div></div>
          <div class="hero-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="copyPrompt()">📋 COPY MY PROMPT</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="resetDesigner()">🔄 DESIGN ANOTHER TASK</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(4)">📚 CREATE ANOTHER MATERIAL</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-visual"><div class="visual-orbs"><span class="o1">📚</span><span class="o2">🧠</span><span class="o3">💻</span><span class="o4">📐</span></div><img class="avatar" alt="Teacher avatar" src="data:image/png;base64," /></div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast">Copied</div>
<script>
const state={step:0,taskType:'',thinking:[],material:''};
const taskTypes=[
 ['📝','WRITE','Essay, explanation, reflection, report'],['🔎','INVESTIGATE','Research, experiment, inquiry'],['🧩','SOLVE','Problem solving, calculation, case study'],['💬','DISCUSS','Debate, discussion, reasoning'],['🎨','CREATE','Poster, model, infographic, presentation'],['📊','ANALYSE','Data, text, source, graph, evidence'],['🛠','BUILD / DESIGN','Prototype, product, model, solution'],['📖','EXPLAIN / TEACH','Teach a concept, demonstration, oral explanation']
];
const thinkingOptions=[
 ['🧠','EXPLAIN WHY','Explain the reasoning behind an answer.'],['🔎','SHOW EVIDENCE','Use data, text, sources, observations or examples.'],['🪜','SHOW THE STEPS','Show calculations, procedures or stages.'],['⚖️','COMPARE','Identify similarities, differences or alternatives.'],['💡','JUSTIFY A CHOICE','Explain why one answer, method or solution was selected.'],['❌','FIND AND CORRECT ERRORS','Identify mistakes and explain corrections.'],['🔄','DRAFT → IMPROVE','Show how an idea or product changes after feedback.'],['🔮','PREDICT','Make a prediction before checking the result.'],['🧩','APPLY','Use knowledge in a new situation.'],['🪞','REFLECT','Explain what was learned, difficult or changed.'],['🤖','EXPLAIN AI USE','Identify what AI helped with and what the student decided independently.']
];
const examples={
 'MATHEMATICS': ['Solve the equation.','Solve the equation and show each step. Explain why you performed each operation. Check your answer using another method.'],
 'SCIENCE': ['Create a poster about photosynthesis.','Create a diagram explaining photosynthesis. Identify the inputs and outputs. Use evidence from the lesson to explain why light is necessary.'],
 'PENDIDIKAN ISLAM': ['Explain Solat Jamak.','Study three situations. Decide whether Solat Jamak is appropriate in each situation. Justify each decision using the relevant principle.'],
 'SEJARAH': ['Make a presentation about independence.','Analyse two historical sources about independence. Identify the main message of each source. Compare the perspectives and justify which source is more useful.'],
 'LANGUAGE': ['Write an essay.','Plan your main ideas first. Write the first draft. Highlight three language improvements. Explain one change you made after reviewing your writing.'],
 'RBT': ['Design a product.','Identify the user problem. Sketch two possible designs. Compare the advantages of both. Justify your final design.'],
 'COMPUTER SCIENCE': ['Write the code.','Predict what the program should do. Write the algorithm. Test the program. Identify one error and explain how it was fixed.']
};
const checklistItems=['The learning objective is clear.','Students must do more than copy or generate an answer.','Students must explain, show evidence, show steps or justify their thinking.','I can identify evidence of individual student understanding.',"The task is appropriate for the students' level.",'AI does not remove the important thinking process.','I know what evidence I will assess.'];
const materials=['Worksheet','Rubric','Exit Ticket','Quiz','Slides','Revision Notes','Differentiated Task','Poster','Student Checklist'];
function init(){
 document.getElementById('taskCards').innerHTML=taskTypes.map((t,i)=>`<button class="choice" data-index="${i}" onclick="selectTask(${i})"><div class="icon">${t[0]}</div><b>${t[1]}</b><small>${t[2]}</small></button>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('thinkingCards').innerHTML=thinkingOptions.map((t,i)=>`<button class="think-card" data-index="${i}" onclick="toggleThinking(${i})"><div class="top"><span>${t[0]}</span><b>${t[1]}</b></div><small>${t[2]}</small></button>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('exampleTabs').innerHTML=Object.keys(examples).map((k,i)=>`<button class="tab ${i===0?'active':''}" onclick="showExample('${k}',this)">${k}</button>`).join(''); showExample(Object.keys(examples)[0],document.querySelector('.tab'));
 document.getElementById('checklist').innerHTML=checklistItems.map((x,i)=>`<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkInput" onchange="updateCheckStatus()"><span>${x}</span></label>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('materialChoices').innerHTML=materials.map((m,i)=>`<button class="material" onclick="selectMaterial('${m}',this)">${m}</button>`).join('');
}
function toast(msg){const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1700)}
function goTo(step){
 document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
 state.step=step;
 const top=document.getElementById('topbar');
 if(step===0){document.getElementById('screen-welcome').classList.add('active');top.style.display='none'}
 else if(step===6){document.getElementById('screen-complete').classList.add('active');top.style.display='none'}
 else{document.getElementById('screen-'+step).classList.add('active');top.style.display='block';updateStepper(step); if(step===4)generatePrompt(); if(step===5)fillShare();}
 window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
function updateStepper(step){document.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach((el,i)=>{const n=i+1;el.classList.toggle('active',n===Math.min(step,4));el.classList.toggle('done',n<Math.min(step,5));});document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width=(Math.min(step,4)/4*100)+'%'}
function toggleOtherSubject(){document.getElementById('subjectOther').style.display=document.getElementById('subject').value==='Other'?'block':'none'}
function toggleOtherLevel(){document.getElementById('levelOther').style.display=document.getElementById('level').value==='Other'?'block':'none'}
function selectTask(i){state.taskType=taskTypes[i][1];document.querySelectorAll('#taskCards .choice').forEach((e,j)=>e.classList.toggle('selected',j===i))}
function nextFromBuild(){const subject=getSubject(),topic=v('topic'),level=getLevel(),obj=v('objective');if(!subject||!topic||!level||!obj||!state.taskType){toast('Complete the learning essentials first');return}goTo(2)}
function toggleThinking(i){const label=thinkingOptions[i][1];const idx=state.thinking.indexOf(label);if(idx>=0)state.thinking.splice(idx,1);else if(state.thinking.length<3)state.thinking.push(label);else{toast('Choose up to THREE thinking strategies');return}document.querySelectorAll('#thinkingCards .think-card').forEach((e,j)=>e.classList.toggle('selected',state.thinking.includes(thinkingOptions[j][1])))}
function showExample(key,btn){document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));if(btn)btn.classList.add('active');const ex=examples[key];document.getElementById('exampleBox').innerHTML=`<div class="example-row"><div class="bad">INSTEAD OF</div><div>${ex[0]}</div></div><div class="example-row"><div class="good">BETTER</div><div>${ex[1]}</div></div>`}
function nextFromThink(){if(state.thinking.length<1){toast('Choose at least ONE visible-thinking strategy');return}if(!v('evidenceAnswer')){toast('Add the evidence that will prove understanding');return}goTo(3)}
function updateCheckStatus(){const checks=[...document.querySelectorAll('.checkInput')];const all=checks.every(c=>c.checked);const s=document.getElementById('checkStatus');s.className='status '+(all?'ready':'review');s.textContent=all?'✅ TASK READY — Thinking is visible.':'🟠 ONE MORE LOOK — Consider strengthening the thinking requirement before assigning the task.'}
function getSubject(){return document.getElementById('subject').value==='Other'?v('subjectOther'):document.getElementById('subject').value}
function getLevel(){return document.getElementById('level').value==='Other'?v('levelOther'):document.getElementById('level').value}
function v(id){return document.getElementById(id)?.value?.trim()||''}
function generatePrompt(){const p=`ROLE
Act as an experienced ${getSubject()} teacher.

CONTEXT
Student level:
${getLevel()}

Topic:
${v('topic')}

Learning objective:
${v('objective')}

TASK
Create a classroom activity where students must:
${state.taskType}

The activity must require students to demonstrate their thinking through:
${state.thinking.join(', ')}

REQUIREMENTS
Use language suitable for ${getLevel()}.
Provide clear student instructions.
Include appropriate scaffolding for weaker students.
Include extension where suitable for stronger students.
Keep the activity realistic for classroom use.
Do not give students the complete answer.
Do not remove the important thinking process.
The teacher must be able to see evidence of student understanding.

EVIDENCE OF LEARNING
Clearly state what the teacher should look for to determine whether students understand the concept.
Teacher's intended evidence: ${v('evidenceAnswer')}`;document.getElementById('promptOutput').textContent=p;return p}
async function copyPrompt(){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatePrompt());toast('Prompt copied')}
function openAI(tool){const p=encodeURIComponent(generatePrompt());if(tool==='chatgpt')window.open('https://chatgpt.com/?q='+p,'_blank');else window.open('https://gemini.google.com/app','_blank'); if(tool==='gemini'){navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatePrompt());toast('Prompt copied — paste it into Gemini')}}
function adaptNotebookLM(){const p=`Use the sources already added to this NotebookLM notebook to support the following classroom task. Do not invent information that is not supported by the sources.

Subject: ${getSubject()}
Level: ${getLevel()}
Topic: ${v('topic')}
Learning objective: ${v('objective')}
Student task: ${state.taskType}
Visible-thinking requirement: ${state.thinking.join(', ')}
Evidence of learning: ${v('evidenceAnswer')}

Create clear student instructions, source-grounded support, and questions that require students to show their thinking. Do not give the complete answer.`;document.getElementById('notebookPrompt').textContent=p;document.getElementById('notebookWrap').style.display='block'}
function selectMaterial(m,btn){state.material=m;document.querySelectorAll('.material').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));btn.classList.add('selected');const p=`Using the SAME learning objective below, create a ${m} that supports the classroom task without removing student thinking.

Subject: ${getSubject()}
Level: ${getLevel()}
Topic: ${v('topic')}
Learning objective: ${v('objective')}
Main task: ${state.taskType}
Visible thinking: ${state.thinking.join(', ')}

Keep it classroom-ready, concise, and suitable for the student level. Require students to show evidence of understanding.`;document.getElementById('materialPrompt').textContent=p;document.getElementById('materialPromptWrap').style.display='block'}
async function copyText(id){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.getElementById(id).textContent);toast('Copied')}
function fillShare(){document.getElementById('shareSubject').value=getSubject()+(v('topic')?' — '+v('topic'):'');document.getElementById('shareTask').value=state.taskType;document.getElementById('shareThinking').value=state.thinking.join(', ')+' — '+v('evidenceAnswer')}
function submitDesign(){const data={subjectUnit:v('shareSubject'),finalTask:v('shareTask'),visibleThinking:v('shareThinking'),tryAfterWorkshop:v('shareTry'),createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),prompt:generatePrompt()};const existing=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aigogyDesigns')||'[]');existing.push(data);localStorage.setItem('aigogyDesigns',JSON.stringify(existing));toast('Saved on this device');goTo(6)}
function resetDesigner(){localStorage.setItem('aigogyLastReset',new Date().toISOString());location.reload()}
init();
</script>
</body>
